biggest_catch: You earn $100 per referral only when the friend opens both new Checking and Savings accounts on the same day and provides your name and account number on the application (it cannot be added later); the bonus lands in your savings within 120 days — the friend may also qualify for a separate $350 new-member bonus on their own.
catches: Friend must be new to Frontwave, 18+, and open new Checking AND Savings accounts on the same day
The referrer's name and account number must be included on the new member's application at the time of submission — if added later, the incentive is not awarded
Referrer must be a current member with a Frontwave savings account in good standing; accounts must remain open and in good standing through processing
Limit one referral bonus per new member; no self-referrals; excludes Frontwave employees and volunteers

Eligibility: friend must live, work, worship, or attend school in San Diego, Riverside, Imperial, or San Bernardino counties (or meet another SEG/military qualification); current members, joint owners, and anyone with a Frontwave account closed in the past 18 months are not eligible
Offer effective as of August 1, 2025; may change or end without notice
Incentive credited within 120 days; a 1099-INT will be issued for tax reporting
